note: Policy review of the NTP 2025-2029 health chapter. Says only that Somalia has expanded DHIS2 and disease-surveillance systems, without describing what DHIS2 does or where it is used; the NTP commitment to digitise and integrate health information systems and the proposed facility registry and interoperability architecture are prescriptions, not stated deployments. HSSP III 2022-2026 is named as the sector strategy covering information systems, with no system named in it.
